t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes are split into two teams, when they are against each other you will choose a basket, each colour basket gives a different amount of mushrooms. Make sure to pick the gnomes that give the best basket for the most amount of mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 teams of gnomes - The yellow basket team and the red basket team. From what I could tell, Yellow basket gnomes were more consistent with their mushroom reward, whereas red basket gnomes were inconsistent and more of a gamble. The teams are as follows: Yellow Basket team is the BLUE GREEN YELLOW ORANGE gnomes.                    Red Basket team is the PURPLE BROWN RED PINK gnomes. The best advice i can give is to AVOID PINK AND BROWN gnomes at all costs. I would also advise to use your x1 rounds to feel out the gnome's mushroom range, and on your x5 rounds to secure as many points securely with the yellow basket team. good luck!
